posts.title: Accidental Congee
posts.description: Dear reader, I made a mistake. I added too much water to the rice. I made accidental congee. And that was a good thing. This week I was trying to make a simple rice and bean salad with dijon vinaigrette. However, I used the wrong measuring cup, had to guess how much rice I'd added, then googled water to rice ratio, vastly overestimated the water, and it turned into rice porridge rather than plain
